title: Jenu Kurumba language - Wikipedia
text: Jenu Kurumba (IPA: [d͡ʒeːnu kurumbɐ]), also known as Jen Kurumba or Jennu Kurumba, is a Southern Dravidian language of the Tamil-Kannada subgroup spoken by the Jenu Kuruba / Kattunayakan tribe. [citation needed] It is often considered to constitute a dialect of Kannada; however, Ethnologue classifies it as a separate language.

title: Archiving Songs and Dance of the Jenu Kurumba Tribe from Karnataka
text: The project archives nine songs and one dance form of the Jenu Kurumba tribe to preserve their culture. Cultural aphasia threatens the Jenu Kurumba tribe due to hegemonic state power structures. The archive includes an introductory video showcasing the tribe's culture and way of life.

title: Jenu Kurumba
text: Jenu Kurumba language is a Dravidian language. It is spoken by people called 'Jenu Kurumbas'. These people live in the borders of Karnataka, Kerala and Tamilnadu.
